reason: We already have a designer and our look works well enough. A carousel full of measurements doesn't tell me what I'd pay or whether it would bring in more bookings.
objection: Every studio shows off its craft. I'd have to pay for a full identity before I could tell if it's better than what I have, and I can't afford a redo.
would_change_my_mind: A before-and-after from a business like mine, showing more bookings or sales after the rebrand.
